FloPlast Straight Couplings are essential 21.5mm uPVC components for reliable solvent weld overflow systems. These white straight couplings are ideal for various plumbing and drainage installations, ensuring a secure connection. A key benefit is that no expansion gap is required on the solvent weld overflow system, simplifying installation. For optimal performance, apply solvent cement evenly to both surfaces of the joint, fully insert the pipe into the socket depth, and remove any surplus cement. Allow five minutes for setting before handling and twelve hours before testing the system.
